register.labelZh: FEED 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: feed on 和 feed off 可以幫助你說明動物以甚麼為食,或機器依靠甚麼取得能量。；你可以把資料 feed into 一個系統,也可以把意見或結果 feed back 給另一個人。；feed back into 和 feed through 可以表示某個結果或改變其後如何影響另一件事。；feed somebody 或 something up 可以表示給虛弱的人或動物吃足夠食物,使其變得更強壯。
register.summaryEn: Feed on and feed off help you explain what an animal eats or what a machine uses as a source of power. You can feed information into a system and feed comments or results back to another person. Feed back into and feed through help you show how one result or change affects something else later. Feed somebody or something up describes giving plenty of food to a weak person or animal.
